question: What proportions govern the neck measure and its single-part projection?
premises: The neck measure is specified as an eighth part.
A projection is specified as one part.
The practitioner is instructed to fashion these elements accordingly.
inference: The neck section must be made as an eighth part with a one-part projection.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eighth part within the total module is not explicit.
plain_english: One should make the neck measure an eighth part and give it a projection of one part.
